metadata.pipeline_stage: Phase 3A.6: Training Eligibility and Split Reconciliation
metadata.scientific_validation_disclaimer: IMPORTANT: Passing automated assertion checks confirms relational schema conformance, unit segregation, dynamic set equality, numerical row-by-row derivation fidelity, and crop-specific screening thresholds. It does NOT constitute empirical scientific validation of field predictive capability. Benchmark cross-validation metrics apply strictly to the 22-class augmented dataset, and historical yield data reflects government district-level aggregates with inherent unmeasured spatial, microclimatic, and farm-management variability.

crop_recommendation_benchmark_validation.validation_protocol_note: Benchmark cross-validation accuracy (~99%) applies exclusively to this 22-class augmented dataset and must not be conflated with empirical real-world farm accuracy.

crop_threshold_consistency_audit.handling_explanation: Records with T < yield <= 2T are retained in cleaned_crop_yield.csv as high observations / flagged for manual review to avoid artificial distribution truncation. Only extreme outliers > 2T were dropped.

Arhar/Tur.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean dry pigeonpea seed at 10-12% moisture.

Bajra.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean pearl millet grain at 12% moisture.

Banana.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Whole fresh fruit bunches. Edible pulp-to-peel ratio ~2:1.

Barley.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean threshed barley grain at 12% moisture.

Black pepper.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Sun-dried black peppercorns (~11% moisture). Green-to-dry ratio ~3:1.

Brinjal.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Fresh tender marketable eggplant fruit (~92% water).

Cabbage.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Fresh trimmed marketable heads containing ~90-93% moisture.

Cardamom.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Commercial cured green cardamom capsules at 10-12% moisture. Fresh green capsule weight is ~5x dry capsule.

Cashewnut.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Raw unshelled cashew nuts with pericarp (~8% moisture). Kernel recovery ~25-28%.

Cashewnut Raw.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Raw unshelled cashew nuts (alias of Cashewnut in DAC&FW records).

Coffee.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean cured green coffee beans (Arabica/Robusta) at 10-11% moisture. Fresh cherry is ~5-6x bean weight.

Coriander.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Dry clean coriander seeds (schizocarps) at 9-10% moisture.

Dry chillies.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Sun-dried cured ripe chillies (~10% moisture). Caution: fresh green chilli yield is ~3.5-4x dry yield.

Dry ginger.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Sun-dried cured rhizomes (~10-12% moisture). Fresh-to-dry conversion ratio ~4.5:1.

Garlic.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Cured dry bulbs with papery scales (~62-66% moisture).

Ginger.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Fresh green unpeeled rhizomes (~78-82% water content).

Gram.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean threshed chickpea seed at 10-12% moisture content.

Grapes.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Fresh marketable table/wine grape clusters (~78-82% water).

Groundnut.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean sun-dried pods in shell (~7-8% moisture). Shelling turnover ~70%.

Guar seed.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Air-dry clean cluster bean seed (~10% moisture). Pod yield is ~4x seed yield.

Horse-gram.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean dry kulthi pulse seed at 10% moisture.

Jowar.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean grain sorghum at 12% moisture content.

Lentil.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean dry lentil seed at 10-12% moisture.

Maize.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean shelled dry grain normalized to 14% moisture content.

Masoor.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean dry red lentil seed at 10-12% moisture (botanically identical to Lentil).

Moong(Green Gram).moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean dry mungbean seed at 10-12% moisture.

Niger seed.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean dry niger seed at 7-8% moisture.

Onion.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Field-cured dry bulbs with tops trimmed (~84-86% moisture).

Paddy.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Rough paddy grain with husk (~13% moisture). Hull-to-rice ratio ~66%.

Papaya.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Fresh commercial whole fruit at table-ripe maturity.

Pineapple.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Fresh mature fruit with crown (~85-87% moisture).

Potato.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Fresh marketable ware tubers (~78% water, ~20-22% dry matter).

Ragi.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean finger millet grain at 12% standard moisture content.

Rapeseed &Mustard.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean dry oilseed (Brassica juncea / campestris) at 6-8% moisture.

Rice.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean dry grain at 12-14% moisture (DAC&FW state reported series).

Rubber.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Commercial Dry Rubber Content (DRC) coagulated sheet/crepe (~1-2% moisture). Raw latex is ~30-35% DRC.

Safflower.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean dry spiny/non-spiny safflower seed at 6-7% moisture.

Sannhamp.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Air-dry extracted bast fiber (~12% moisture). Total dry stem biomass is ~4x fiber yield.

Sesamum.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean dry sesame seeds at 6% moisture content.

Small millets.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean grain of minor millets (kodo, foxtail, proso, barnyard, little) at 12% moisture.

Soyabean.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean threshed dry soybeans at 8-10% moisture.

Sugarcane.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Fresh millable cane containing ~70-75% water. Commercial sucrose recovery 9-11%.

Tapioca.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Fresh harvested cassava roots containing ~60-65% moisture and ~30-35% starch.

Tea.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Commercial made black tea (~3% moisture). Green leaf weight is ~4.5x made tea.

Tobacco.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Barn-cured or sun-cured dry leaf (~10-12% moisture).

Tomato.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Fresh ripe salad/processing fruit with ~93-95% water content.

Turmeric.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Officially cured dry rhizome (Spice Board standard). Caution: local district figures occasionally conflate with green rhizome (15-25 t/ha).

Urad.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean dry blackgram seed at 10-12% moisture.

Wheat.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean threshed wheat grain at 12% moisture. Distinct from total biological biomass.

unmatched_reasons_summary.state_bifurcation_telangana: Telangana created in 2014; IMD 30-year normal table recorded these districts under Andhra Pradesh
unmatched_reasons_summary.district_divisions: Districts split after 2000 (e.g., Medinipur bifurcated into Paschim/Purba Medinipur; Bangalore into Rural/Urban; Bagalkot from Bijapur)
unmatched_reasons_summary.spelling_nomenclature_variants: Historic IMD spelling differences (e.g., Visakhapatanam vs Visakhapatnam, SPSR Nellore vs Nellore, Kadapa vs Cuddapah)
